title: Spring Data JPA and API Layers
description: Spring Data JPA with Hibernate on an embedded H2 database: entities and IDs, repositories with derived queries and @Query, reading the generated SQL, then the S6 project day that separates controller, service and repository layers, maps entities to DTOs and pages and sorts results.
sourceCoverageNotes: Course slice: Standard S1-S13 and Fast FT1-FT8. This module covers Standard S5-S6.
S6 is a Project day: its three rows map 'shared' to their canonical topics (taught pages, also the FT4 Fast rows) and to the day-level project brief api-layers-and-dtos-project.
Fast mapping: FT3 rows 0-3 and FT4 rows 0-2 map here.
Planned module coding lab (Standard lab overlay, Lab day S5): authored in this module's PR, mvn -q -o test, embedded H2, no container engine.
